title: Lost Money to Online Fraud? What to Do in the First Hour: 1930, Cybercrime Portal and Your Bank
seoTitle: How to Report Cyber Fraud: 1930, Portal and Bank Steps
seoDescription: Call 1930, file on cybercrime.gov.in and alert your bank within the hour. Plus RBI liability limits, the new ₹25,000 compensation and the Ombudsman route.
excerpt: A minute-by-minute checklist for fraud victims, the details to keep ready, RBI's liability rules now and from January 2027, how frozen money is returned, and when to go to the RBI Ombudsman.
